panels.title: Data through
panels.description:
Last day included in this load (the nightly window ends at 23:59 UTC that day).

**Source:** n360.runs, written by load.py only after every data check passes  
**Filter:** loaded runs only; the latest  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(window_end, '%e %b %Y') AS data_through
        FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded' ORDER BY loaded_at DESC, data_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last night
panels.description:
Result of the latest nightly run. A stopped night leaves the previous good night on screen.

**Source:** n360.runs (load.py writes one row per night, loaded or not)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest run

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(status) AS status FROM n360.runs ORDER BY loaded_at DESC, data_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Configuration
panels.description:
From the newest weekly configuration read of each VA. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_latest (n360.va_config_snapshot)  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(current_engine) AS `VAs on V8 or later`, count() AS `VAs read`,
               sum(mcp_servers_live) AS `MCP servers live`, sum(supervisory_rules_on) AS `Supervisory rules on`
        FROM n360.v_va_config_latest WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Changed since last read
panels.description:
VAs whose configuration differs between their two newest weekly reads.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the two newest reads per VA

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS changed FROM n360.v_va_config_change WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Engine and configuration per VA
panels.description:
Each VA's newest configuration read. Green = engine V8 or later (spec 9). Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer, c.engine_version AS Engine,
               toString(c.current_engine) AS `V8 or later`, c.v8_playbooks AS `V8 playbooks`,
               c.legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`, c.mcp_servers_live AS `MCP servers`,
               c.supervisory_rules_on AS `Supervisory rules`, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(c.snapshot_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(c.snapshot_date, '%b %Y')) AS `Read on`,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', c.account, '&var-va=', toString(c.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_config_latest AS c INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = c.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY c.current_engine, Customer, VA

panels.title: V8 playbooks and legacy intents per VA
panels.description:
Per VA, how much is built on V8 playbooks against legacy intents, from the newest read. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_latest  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, c.v8_playbooks AS `V8 playbooks`, c.legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`
        FROM n360.v_va_config_latest AS c INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = c.bot_id
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY VA

panels.title: Playbook executions, 31 days
panels.description:
Executions per playbook over the 31 days to the data-through day. "Built, not run" = the playbook exists but ran 0 times. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.playbook_day  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pb.playbook AS Playbook, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer, sum(pb.executions) AS `Executions, 31 days`,
               if(sum(pb.executions) = 0, 'Built, not run', 'Running') AS Status
        FROM n360.playbook_day AS pb INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = pb.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND pb.day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 31
        GROUP BY pb.playbook, v.va_name, v.channels, ac.display_name ORDER BY `Executions, 31 days`, Customer

panels.title: Authoring sessions and assistant questions, customer users
panels.description:
Per week, sessions in the authoring tool and questions to the analytics assistant by customer users only (staff left out). Complete weeks. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.cortex_day, n360.explorer_day  
**Filter:** Customer; customer users  
**Window:** dashboard time range, complete weeks

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(c.day)) AS time, sum(c.authoring_sessions) AS `Authoring sessions`,
               sum(e.questions) AS `Analytics-assistant questions`
        FROM n360.cortex_day AS c INNER JOIN n360.explorer_day AS e
             ON e.account = c.account AND e.day = c.day AND e.user_type = c.user_type
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND c.user_type = 'customer' AND $__dateFilter(c.day)
          AND toMonday(c.day) >= toDate($__fromTime) AND toMonday(c.day) + 6 <= (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded')
        GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Configuration changes since the last read
panels.description:
What changed per VA between its two newest weekly reads. Phase 2 (proposed design, tested on synthetic only): field meanings are open questions in docs/08_DECISIONS.md. Empty until the company export carries these files.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the two newest reads per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(ch.previous_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(ch.previous_date, '%b %Y')) AS `From`,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(ch.snapshot_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(ch.snapshot_date, '%b %Y')) AS `To`, arrayStringConcat(ch.changes, '; ') AS Changes
        FROM n360.v_va_config_change AS ch INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = ch.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = ch.account
        WHERE ch.account IN (${account:singlequote})
